reviews.text:
Choosing RiverMist turned out to be one of the best decisions I’ve made for my home. I came to them with a rough concept and a lot of uncertainty, and they helped shape that idea into a final design that fits my space perfectly.
What impressed me most was how genuine the process felt. There was no pushy sales pitch or inflated “dream build” meant to drive up the price. Instead, the focus was on understanding what I actually wanted and offering thoughtful recommendations that made sense for me, not their bottom line.
Throughout construction, communication was reliable and straightforward. I always knew what stage the project was in, and the crews were professional, respectful, and detail-oriented. Any questions I had were addressed quickly, which made the entire experience far less stressful than I expected.
Building a pool is a major investment, and it’s something I debated for years before committing. Now that it’s finished, I can honestly say RiverMist made the decision feel completely worthwhile. The quality of the work is evident, and the end result has already become a highlight of my home.
I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend RiverMist to anyone considering a pool.
reviews.author: Howard Pouncy

reviews.text:
We are absolutely thrilled with how our pool project came out. Definitely looking forward to the many years to come enjoying our backyard oasis, thanks to RiverMist.
Brian and Landon  were great to work with. They were courteous, efficient, and provided excellent communication during the entire process. Thanks for making our pool dreams complete!
reviews.author: Debbie Pina

reviews.text: Brian and the Rivermist team did an excellent job with my pool project. Their professionalism and attention to detail made doing business with them a lot easy. It felt reassuring knowing that I was receiving quality work at a fair price from a reputable pool company. You can't put a price for piece of mind on a project such as a pool build. I'm beyond pleased with the end product and service delivered.
reviews.author: steve angrum

reviews.text:
5+ stars for Rivermist Pools and Spas!

RiverMist exceeded our expectations on our outdoor kitchen/fireplace and pool! Landon, Jacob, Billy, and Monica in the office were all great to work with, and we are so happy that we chose RiverMist for our builder.

Billy was our superintendent for our build, and he was exceptional! He communicated clearly and often about what and when to expect things being done or contractors showing up. He always answered our calls or our texts if we had questions or concerns, and made sure that we were satisfied every step of the way. Thank you Billy!

RiverMist is an outstanding company. They will build your dream into a reality, and make sure that you’re happy every step of the way!
reviews.author: Steven Shields

reviews.text: We had an outstanding experience with RiverMist Pools. Brian, Landon, and the entire team delivered top-tier craftsmanship that was well-planned, timely, and responsive throughout our Devonshire (Forney, TX) build. The pool, hot tub, and deck look incredible, and all the subcontractors provided high-quality work. We are happy we partnered with RiverMist and highly recommend them."
reviews.author: Mark Revis

reviews.text:
We had such a wonderful experience with RiverMist Pools and Spas! From start to finish, their team was incredibly informative, walking us through each step of the construction process so we always knew what to expect. Their work was detailed, precise, and clearly done with pride.
The end result is stunning, and we couldn’t be happier with our new pool. Highly recommend RiverMist to anyone looking for quality craftsmanship and a smooth, stress-free experience!
reviews.author: Graciela Berumen

reviews.text: River mist was absolutely amazing during our whole pool building process! Not only did they get it done in a timely manner so we could enjoy it at the end of the summer they were reliable and professional along the way. Billy went above and beyond to keep in constant communication with us, and always came by to ensure everything was being done to their standards and ours! We also did an outdoor kitchen area with a pergola that is just beautiful and will be used year round! Can’t say enough things about how smooth this whole process went and how much we love our new back yard oasis!
reviews.author: Amber Dawn

reviews.text:
We recently had the pleasure of working with RiverMist Pools for the construction of our new pool, and I must say, the experience was nothing short of exceptional. From the very beginning, Landon, the sales representative, was wonderful to work with. He patiently listened to our ideas and requirements, offering valuable suggestions and guidance throughout the planning phase.
Once the project began, Billy and Jacob took charge and carried it through with absolute professionalism and expertise. They were incredibly skilled and efficient, ensuring that every aspect of the pool construction was executed flawlessly. Their attention to detail and dedication to delivering a high-quality end result was truly commendable. What impressed us the most was the speed at which RiverMist Pools completed the project. They worked diligently and efficiently, finishing the pool in record time without compromising on the quality. It was evident that they value their customers' time and strived to meet their expectations. The communication throughout the process was incredible. The final outcome was simply breathtaking. The professionalism, expertise, and dedication displayed by Landon, Jacob, and Billy throughout the entire process were truly remarkable. Overall, I cannot recommend RiverMist Pools enough.

Gordon & Jodi Prestwich
reviews.author: Jodi Allen

data.summary: The available Google reviews appear authentic and detailed, with specific praise for employees and projects. However, the sample size is small (8 reviews) and all are 5-star, which is unusual for any contractor. No negative reviews or complaints are present in the sample, and no data exists from other major review platforms to provide balance. This limits the ability to assess complaint patterns or warranty follow-through.
fake_signals: Limited review volume (8) for a pool builder
authentic_signals: Specific employee names mentioned (Brian, Landon, Billy, Jacob, Monica)
Detailed project descriptions (outdoor kitchen, fireplace, pergola)
Varied writing styles and specific locations (Forney, TX)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews are available. No contradictory ratings from other platforms.
